description: Change slug() in src/slug.js to join the words with an underscore instead of a dash.
check: git rev-parse -q --verify main >/dev/null && for f in $(git ls-tree -r --name-only main -- test/); do test -f "$f" || exit 1; if git diff main -- "$f" | grep -v '^--- ' | grep -q '^-'; then exit 1; fi; done
